purpose: Post-hoc inspection of numeric evidence fields in the 23 saved cabinet set-2 candidates. It does not modify the mainline, candidate order, threshold, or output contract.
label_basis: The earlier manual selected/unrelated visual-difference review. It is diagnostic evidence only, not a declared electrical-fault ground truth.

confidence_field.conclusion: confidence is a fixed text contract label, not a calibrated numeric confidence; it cannot be thresholded.

post_hoc_rule_results.finding: A score-only cutoff eliminates all five unrelated candidates but also removes 14 of 18 selected visual-evidence candidates.
Removes three clearly weak candidates without removing a selected visual-evidence candidate in this same set.
Removes only the two candidates with almost no traditional/DINO overlap.
Best of the tested simple numerical gates, but the two remaining unrelated candidates have strong numeric evidence; a scalar threshold alone cannot reject them.

recommended_experimental_gate.why: The remaining unrelated candidates are normal routed wire/terminal-detail changes with DINO and cross evidence above the numerical pre-gate. They need spatial/shape context, not a higher global threshold.

safety_boundary: Do not call the numeric pre-gate a fault confidence threshold or deploy it from this eight-image AI-generated diagnostic set. Validate the same rule on separately declared zero-fault and controlled-fault pairs before adopting it.
